t: A quiet, low-power Linux computer for home servers and smart home hubs.
steps: Buy the board from Hardkernel or ameriDroid. Pick the IO Header version for sensor projects.
Get a 5 volt, 3 amp USB-C power supply and an Ethernet cable.
Download the Hardkernel Ubuntu image or an Armbian build from the ODROID wiki.
Flash the image to the eMMC with the tools the wiki describes.
Connect HDMI, a keyboard, and the network cable. Then power it on.
Log in, update the system, and try a WiringPi or Python blink example.
For a smart home hub, install Home Assistant OS on its own.
meta: Open Code. From $99. A few stores.
